bestiary.name: Succubus
bestiary.description: A succubus is a beautiful fiend that feeds on desire and devotion. They glide between the Lower Planes and the Material with practiced ease, wearing whatever form best unlocks their target's longing. Up close they are unnaturally warm to the touch, their scent a layered perfume of incense, salt, and the faint sulfur of their origin. Patient seducers and merciless harvesters of souls, they treat every encounter as a campaign — sometimes spanning years — and every climax as a contract.

sexualTraits.name: Charming Kiss
sexualTraits.mechanical: Once per round when a creature kisses a succubus or is kissed by one, the target must make a DC 15 Wisdom save (DC = 10 + the succubus's Sexuality bonus + Cha modifier). On a failure, the target becomes Charmed by the succubus for 1 hour and gains one stage of Aroused. Each subsequent kiss from the succubus during the duration imposes disadvantage on saves against her carnal effects.
sexualTraits.flavor: Her mouth tastes of dark wine and an old promise — once kissed, the rest of the world seems suddenly muted, as if every other voice were speaking through wool.

sexualTraits.name: Drain Vitality
sexualTraits.mechanical: When a creature climaxes while in physical contact with the succubus, the succubus regains hit points equal to a roll on her Sex Die + her Sexuality bonus, and the target's maximum hit points are reduced by the same amount until they finish a long rest. A creature reduced to 0 maximum HP this way dies, and the succubus carries their soul to her patron.
sexualTraits.flavor: She inhales softly at the moment of climax, as if catching a candle's last breath, and the world dims by exactly that much.

sexualTraits.name: Shapechanger
sexualTraits.mechanical: As an action, the succubus can polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid she has previously seen, or back into her true form. Her statistics other than size are the same in each form; equipment is not transformed. She reverts on death.
sexualTraits.flavor: She will be the lover you almost had, the rival you secretly admired, the saint you should have been — whichever wound she finds open first.

sexualTraits.name: Telepathic Bond
sexualTraits.mechanical: The succubus can communicate telepathically with any creature she has touched intimately, across any distance on the same plane. Through the bond she may whisper words of encouragement (advantage on the next Charisma check made by the target within 1 hour) once per long rest.
sexualTraits.flavor: Her voice arrives in your head with the casual familiarity of a thought you almost had.

sexualTraits.name: Etherealness
sexualTraits.mechanical: The succubus can magically enter the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa, as an action (no concentration). She often uses this to slip into dreams adjacent to a sleeping target.
sexualTraits.flavor: She does not so much leave a room as step sideways out of its memory.

bestiary.sexualNorms: Within infernal courts, succubi (and their incubus-formed peers) are courtly predators — pleasure is the coin of power, and any seduction without a written or sworn return is considered amateur work. They expect explicit favors in return for the pleasure they give, and openly mock devils who use coercion instead of artistry. Among mortals they typically mimic local norms with surgical precision, including current expectations around consent and pacing; deviating from the target's stated boundaries is regarded by other succubi as clumsy and beneath them.
bestiary.recreationalPractices: Off-duty, succubi pursue connoisseur-grade hedonism: vintages of wine pressed from grapes grown on volcanic ash, masquerade balls where every kiss is a wager, contests of erotic poetry recited in burning libraries, and long, ritualized exchanges of touch with peers that take days and leave no marks. They prize ingenuity over endurance and will tolerate a clumsy partner only if the partner is genuinely surprising.
bestiary.breedingPractices: Succubi do not bear children in the mortal sense. When ordered or inspired, a succubus may carry a cambion to term — a pregnancy conducted across both the Ethereal and Material Planes that lasts roughly a mortal year and produces a half-fiend with a soul-debt to its succubus mother. More commonly, the 'progeny' of a succubus are the seduced mortals she leaves behind: lovers reshaped by months or years of attention, who carry forward her tastes, her habits, and sometimes — at the worst moments — her voice.
bestiary.encounterHooks: 1) A noble's spouse has been missing for a season and writes weekly letters that are too articulate to be fake but too eager to be safe. 2) A new poet has taken a duchy by storm; their sonnets are perfect, except all of them are addressed to the same unnamed lover. 3) An order of paladins is quietly losing members to 'retirement'; each retiree leaves on the same day of the month, smiling. 4) A merchant offers the party a discount they cannot refuse, on the condition that one of them spend a night as a guest in his estate's east wing.

bestiary.name: Celestial Acolyte

sexualTraits.name: Divine Radiance

bestiary.recreationalPractices: Slow, intimate, romantic sex with lots of kissing and emotional connection.

bestiary.encounterHooks: 1) A cathedral acolyte confesses to the party that visions of mortal love haunt their prayers — and asks for discretion, not absolution. 2) A paladin order suspects a radiant novice has been meeting someone after vespers; the trail leads to a rooftop garden. 3) A dying pilgrim claims an acolyte's blessing left them warm in ways that had nothing to do with healing magic.

bestiary.name: Pixie

bestiary.name: Kenku

sexualTraits.name: Blood Ecstasy
sexualTraits.mechanical: Bite deals heavy pleasure + life drain. Creatures who climax often become addicted.

bestiary.sexualNorms: View mortals as prey and playthings. Maintain gothic courts of thralls.
bestiary.recreationalPractices: Elegant drawn-out seduction, blood orgies, hypnotic domination.
bestiary.breedingPractices: Create spawn through draining and ritual.
bestiary.encounterHooks: 1) A masquerade's host has not cast a reflection all evening — and every guest is having the time of their life. 2) A village offers the party a manor key if they end the 'romance' killing livestock. 3) An ancient vampire proposes a treaty: one willing donor per month, and the roads stay safe.
